sources.name: OpenAI plugin examples (supersedes the deprecated openai/skills)
sources.license_state: mixed; each plugin's own licence is authoritative
sources.note: Curated Codex plugin examples: .codex-plugin/plugin.json plus companion skills/, agents/, commands/, hooks.json, assets. Verified 2026-09-24: 7.1k stars, 306 commits.

sources.name: Agent Plugins packaging specification
sources.note: Portable plugin contract; a client may conform while supporting only one component type (skills or MCP servers), so package-level badges cannot replace per-feature compatibility records.

sources.name: Microsoft Agent Package Manager
sources.note: Dependency-resolution candidate behind the material-install edge: apm.yml manifest, apm.lock.yaml integrity hashes, install policy separate from run policy, CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM export, drift audit, MCP trust prompts. Verified 2026-09-24: 3.9k stars, 1,989 commits.

sources.name: skills.sh directory, leaderboard and audit pages
sources.license_state: site content unverified for reuse; the referenced skills keep their own licences
sources.note: Ingestion-surface candidate: catalog, search, curated, detail (content hash when snapshotted) and audit endpoints; authentication via Vercel OIDC tokens, so an importer must not assume anonymous access. Audit states are per scanner (Gen, Socket, Snyk) and can disagree or stay pending: keep scanner, date, digest, severity and coverage as separate fields.

sources.name: ClawHub skill and plugin registry
sources.license_state: registry code and listed artifacts differ; per-artifact review required
sources.note: Versioned skills, search and CLI. Distinguishes code plugins, bundle plugins and whole-agent packages: not every artifact is a portable Markdown skill.

sources.name: Official MCP Registry (metadata service)
sources.license_state: registry code not designed or supported for self-hosting; interface is published
sources.note: Stores standardized server.json metadata, not packages. Namespace verification is not code-security approval. Preview service: breaking changes and data resets possible.

sources.name: JFrog Artifactory agent-skills repository type (open beta)
sources.license_state: JFrog product documentation; no artifact licence implied
sources.note: Actual private package storage with SKILL.md indexing and a ClawHub-compatible API (jf agent skills). Scanning depends on Xray configuration: presence in the registry never means scanned or approved.
